description: Internal build-size budgets for the published AIEd static site. These are project policy, not GitHub guarantees. GitHub Pages documents a 1 GB published-site ceiling; the blocking budget leaves at least 250 MB of headroom below a conservative interpretation of that ceiling.

enforcement.reason: Observation mode: the reviewed baseline measured 2,070,889,441 published bytes (2070.89 MB) on 2026-11-06, above the 750 MB blocking budget and the conservative 1 GB hosting marker. Enforcement stays off until a reviewed reduction or an explicit budget decision; do not raise the budget silently.
